task.name: Unload_strike_truck
task.when: After the equipment truck reaches the approved post-event storage location

step.action: Confirm the unloading sequence, crew positions, and door-opening method in 📦 Truck_Load_Plan.
Clear the unloading area of people who are not on the unloading crew.
Have the Build Lead open and secure the truck door using the method in 📦 Truck_Load_Plan.
step.ifThen: IF the door is under pressure or does not open normally, THEN stop and have the Build Lead establish a controlled unloading method.

step.action: Unload each transport group in the sequence printed in 📦 Truck_Load_Plan.
Move each unloaded group to its assigned storage location.
Count each stored group against 📦 Truck_Load_Plan.
Record every missing or damaged item on 📦 Truck_Load_Plan.
Inspect the empty cargo area for equipment, hardware, trash, and MOOP.

passWhen.criterion: Every transport group is accounted for at its assigned storage location.
Every missing or damaged item is recorded.
The truck cargo area is empty and the truck is closed and latched.
